stem: Why is Frank surprised when he sees the blue ribbon on his waffle?

options.label: F
options.text: He forgets to follow the rules of the contest.

options.label: G
options.text: He thinks his waffle looks too bad to earn a ribbon.

options.label: H
options.text: He believes that Mr. Todd needs more time to pick the winners.

options.label: J
options.text: He has never received a ribbon from Mr. Todd before.
